description: This Java class defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardPowerSaving' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardNightMode'. It manages power-saving state, updates UI watermarks, and creates overlay data related to power-saving mode in the keyboard application.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardPowerSaving
classes.description: An abstract class that manages power-saving mode UI updates and overlay creation for the keyboard.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes power-saving state observers and sets up UI updates accordingly.

methods.name: generateWatermark
methods.description: Generates a list of watermarks, adding a power-saving icon if active.

methods.name: createOverlayDataCreator
methods.description: Creates and returns an overlay data creator configured for power-saving mode.
